events.title: Alternative School presents: Open Enrollment (Open Decks)
events.description:
Alternative School presents Open Enrollment every Thursday at Northern Lights Lounge.

Our weekly vinyl only open decks night welcomes DJs of all experience levels to get behind the turntables, share music, discover new sounds, and connect with the community.

Whether it’s your first time playing out or you’ve been collecting records for years, everyone is welcome.

Sign up in person and choose your preferred one hour set between 7pm and midnight. All slots are available on a first come, first served basis, so arrive early to secure your spot.

Bring your own records
events.address: 660 W. Baltimore Street; Detroit, MI 48202; United States

events.title: Requiem For A Machine Soul: AbuQadim Haqq Graphic Novel Release Event
events.description:
Latona Expansion Group LLC  presents Requiem For A Machine Soul, the release event for AbuQadim Haqq's new graphic novel, built with Rick Wade from a short story by Shinichiro Watanabe.
Humanity has conquered the stars, but surrendered its freedom. This is the night that story comes off the page and into the room. Detroit techno, Japanese science fiction, and Black speculative art collide for one night only, in one of Detroit's oldest rooms.
Music by Marcus Raute and Rick Wade.

events.title: BerettaMusic and Friends - DJ Cent, Ryan Sadorus, Marcus Harris
events.description:
30 MONTHS. 30 PARTIES. 30 IN A ROW. 

For two and a half years, BerettaMusic & Friends monthly residency has been a constant in downtown Detroit's house music community. Month after month, the label and night have brought people together who continue to push our city's underground music culture forward with an eye towards those that contribute back.

Consistency is clutch, quality is key and a healthy and unwavering love for the music and a commitment to keeping Detroit's dance floors alive.

This November marks our 30th consecutive monthly gathering, and we're celebrating with another outstanding lineup:

DJ CENT - ADRIEL FANTASTIQUE! - DJ RYTE NOU - MARCUS HARRIS - RYAN SADORUS

This night has grown into something we're deeply proud of. A place for established artists, new voices, old friends, and new connections, all united by the music to come together and build bridges with one another and the future.

To every artist who's shared our decks, every friend who's spread the word, and everyone who's spent a night dancing with us — thank you for making these 30 months possible.

SPKRBOX | 200 Grand River, Downtown Detroit

Saturday, November 14 | 10 PM


#BerettaMusic #DetroitHouseMusic #DetroitTechno #HouseMusicCulture #DetroitNightlife
